products.name: Sakura Ronin Hoodie
products.subtitle: A lone journey, a blossoming hope.
products.description: Oversized hoodie carrying the Sakura Ronin — a wandering swordsman beneath falling cherry blossoms. Embroidered zardozi and layered threadwork across the back panel.

images.alt: Sakura Ronin Hoodie — back panel embroidery

embroidery.motifStory: The ronin walks beneath blossoms that fall faster than he moves — beauty and transience stitched at 40 hours.

products.name: Koi Current Tee
products.subtitle: One crest, one current. Swim quietly.
products.description: Boxy drop-shoulder tee with a single tonal koi crest embroidered high on the chest — thread-on-thread, discovered rather than announced.

embroidery.motifStory: The koi swims in single-color satin — perseverance rendered in one quiet pass.

products.name: Red Sun Motif Tote
products.subtitle: A flat crimson disc on raw canvas. Daylight carried.
products.description: Heavy raw-canvas tote with the Red Sun motif worked flat and frontal — a symbol of new beginnings on an everyday carry.

images.alt: Red Sun Motif Tote — embroidery detail

embroidery.threadComposition: Crimson silk floss on raw canvas
embroidery.motifStory: A flat crimson disc, minimal, paired with mountain linework.

products.name: Ascendant Hoodie
products.subtitle: The crest carries. Quietly.
products.description: Heavyweight fleece hoodie with the Ascendant Crest worked as a tonal chest mark — the everyday hero’s emblem, stitched to be noticed slowly.

embroidery.threadComposition: Tonal charcoal bullion wire, silk core
embroidery.motifStory: Shield-crest geometry, gold on deep red in the loud line — here rendered tonal, charcoal on ash.

products.name: Guardian Stripes Pullover
products.subtitle: Speed lines of those who show up first.
products.description: Loopback crewneck pullover with Guardian Stripes running diagonal across the chest — navy bands and burst-yellow knots in structural sashiko grid.

embroidery.motifStory: Diagonal action-line bands — the geometry of first responders.

products.name: Herald Cape Jacket
products.subtitle: Icons are ideas. Wear yours.
products.description: Structured cape jacket with full-back Ascendant relief in zardozi wire — a showcase garment for those who carry their own weight. Limited numbered edition.

embroidery.threadComposition: Silver-gilt zari couched cord, French knots
embroidery.motifStory: Crest relief built in two techniques — couching for the form, knots for the light.

products.name: Royal Procession Jacket
products.subtitle: Moments and empires, embroidered for now.
products.description: Chore jacket carrying the Royal Procession across the back panel in couched zari — caparisoned elephant beneath a Mughal arch, festive and full.

embroidery.motifStory: The procession enters the courtyard — ceremony stitched in continuous metallic inlay.

products.name: Arch Jaal Silk Scarf
products.subtitle: Courtyards of patience — geometry as devotion.
products.description: Mulberry silk scarf with the Arch Jaal lattice worked in tonal gold — Mughal geometry held to a whisper.

images.alt: Arch Jaal Silk Scarf — lattice macro

embroidery.motifStory: Mughal arch lattice, symmetric, tonal — the geometry reads only at arm’s length.

products.name: Sashiko Selvedge Denim
products.subtitle: Reinforced where work lives. Aged with patina.
products.description: Raw selvedge denim work pants with sashiko lattices anchoring the high-friction zones — white cotton thread over deep indigo, built to age.

embroidery.threadComposition: Crisp white cotton thread on raw indigo
embroidery.motifStory: Functional geometric needlework that strengthens and signatures the cloth at once.

products.name: Crewel Cashmere Cardigan
products.subtitle: Alpine botanicals in thick wool relief.
products.description: Hand-woven wool cardigan with Kashmiri crewel botanicals in 2-ply natural yarn — dimensional relief and real insulation in one garment.

embroidery.motifStory: Wild flora and alpine botanicals, hooked-loop relief through a fine aari.

products.name: Monogram Poplin Shirt
products.subtitle: Your initials in precision satin. Nothing louder.
products.description: Supima cotton poplin shirt with a bespoke satin monogram at the cuff — the atelier’s quietest personalization.

embroidery.motifStory: Precision satin initials — patron-chosen thread and placement.

products.name: Nocturne Velvet Crewel Vest
products.subtitle: Two techniques, one night garden.
products.description: Cotton velvet vest layered with crewel night-blooms and French-knot stars — an after-hours collector piece, numbered edition.

images.alt: Nocturne Velvet Crewel Vest — knot stars macro

embroidery.motifStory: Night garden in two hands — crewel for the blooms, knots for the constellation.

products.name: Heritage Flora Silk Scarf
products.subtitle: Botanical chain shadow-work on mulberry twill.
products.description: Mulberry silk scarf with Chikankari botanical chain — shadow-work flowers at 14 hours, heirloom-soft.

images.alt: Heritage Flora Silk Scarf — shadow-work macro

embroidery.motifStory: Fluid florals in shadow-work and chain looping, calibrated tension throughout.
